preliminaryDirections.thesis: Restore the two legacy Dashboard journeys so a signed-in learner can understand current learning commitments or competitive standing without leaving the dashboard.
preliminaryDirections.primaryCta: Courses: open the most relevant course row; Community: open the full leaderboard. Row-level follow remains subordinate.
preliminaryDirections.successCondition: At the same viewport and data state, block order, grouping, copy intent, density and interactions match legacy, with differences limited to documented canon translations.
readingOrder: Courses: Upcoming live sessions when non-empty
tradeoffs: Preserves legacy density rather than simplifying course progress to one generic bar.
Keeps five independent request lifetimes, so partial availability is visible by design.
Requires new contract vocabulary and four FE query ports but no broad backend redesign.
Community visual parity remains provisional until authenticated preview evidence exists.
legacyDivergence: Internal navigation uses router.push/actions rather than internal href data.
Heroicon semantic vocabulary replaces direct Phosphor imports; top-three rank treatment uses approved semantic tokens.
League and TopLearners gain explicit recoverable error states because real failures cannot remain an endless skeleton under current canon.
TopLearners uses truthful initial following state only if the additive field is approved.

risks: A generic LabelledProgressRow would erase thumbnail, trial status and dimension legend and therefore fail visible parity.
Reusing WhoToFollow for Community would change the product from competition to discovery.
A shared all-tab loading state would violate independent block ownership and cause unnecessary layout delay.
Rendering follow as always-false would lie about existing relationships.
smallestRepairs: Use honest course and ranked-user list contracts.
Approve the additive following field or omit follow toggling until truthful state is available.
